newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian shares fall in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian shares fall in light trade.

text.p: Egyptian share prices fell on Monday in relatively light trade with no clear direction.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index slipped 0.15 points to close at 239.77 points in turnover of 17.5 million pounds ($5.1 million).
Amriyah Cement, the most active stock, shed 0.05 to end the day at 58.45 pounds and East Delta Flour Mills, the second most active, lost 0.51 to close at 39.00.
But another active cement company, Helwan Portland Cement, rose sharply to finish 2.00 up at 54.00, and Upper Egypt Flour Mills was 0.80 up at 49.20
The CMA index for openly traded firms fell to 358.00 points from 358.75 on Sunday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 169.32 from 169.29 points.
